violations.why: The ISR can overwrite v_onyx between the loop init and the condition check, so the check sees 50 instead of 0.
The ISR can overwrite v_onyx after the init, so the index used at line 24 is 50 rather than the value the task set.
The v_onyx++ read-modify-write is not atomic, so the ISR's write of 50 is overwritten by the stale incremented value.
The ISR can overwrite the incremented v_onyx before it is used as the array index at line 24.
